shots.label: 产品 Hero 特写
shots.image_prompt: Hero close-up of an iced latte in a tall translucent plastic cup. The cup body has a deep blue Luckin deer-head logo on the left and a small red runner mascot figurine on the right side. A red plastic stir stick shaped like a tiny runner figurine sits in the cream foam top. Soft cream-white foam dome on top of caramel-streaked iced milk. The cup sits on a clean off-white marble countertop, with a small clear glass vase of fresh green leaves on the right and a stack of two minimalist white-cover books on the right side. A folded white-and-red flag-pattern cloth drapes onto the bottom-left corner. Bright soft natural daylight from the upper-left window casts gentle geometric shadows on the wall. Photo-real, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, commercial photography, 8K, no people in frame.
shots.video_prompt: Camera: subtle push-in with gentle focus pull, smooth and steady across the full clip. Action: cream foam settles a fraction, soft window-light slowly drifts across the cup surface, faint condensation forms on the plastic. Keep the Luckin deer-head logo, the red runner mascot and the red stirrer perfectly readable and identical throughout. Avoid: warped surface, label distortion, logo flicker, text warping, frame stutter, color shift.
